explication: FOSSA CLI analyzes a project directory, detects dependencies across supported languages and build tools, and uploads analysis to FOSSA, where users can review results and generate reports. The repository also contains container and Go-binary scanning in Millhone, Berkeley DB parsing, and a diagnostic walker. README statements support the principal workflow; sampled Rust excerpts establish the Millhone and Berkeley DB internals. The main Haskell analysis implementation was not sampled, so its internal call relationships are not asserted.
